definitions.explanation: A moderate cooking temperature between low heat ({弱火|よわび}) and high heat ({強火|つよび}). One of the standard heat settings referred to in Japanese cooking instructions.

examples.japanese: {中火|なかび}で{炒|いた}めてください。
{中火|なかび}にして5{分|ふん}{煮|に}る。
examples.english: Set to medium heat and simmer for 5 minutes.

examples.japanese: {最初|さいしょ}は{強火|つよび}で{沸騰|ふっとう}させてから{中火|なかび}に{落|お}とす。
examples.english: First bring to a boil on high heat, then reduce to medium heat.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the three standard heat levels used in Japanese cooking:
- {弱火|よわび} (low heat)
- {中火|なかび} (medium heat)
- {強火|つよび} (high heat)

Additionally, とろ{火|び} (very low heat/simmer) is sometimes used. These terms appear constantly in recipes and cooking instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中火|なかび}で{焼|や}く (to grill on medium heat)
- {中火|なかび}で{煮|に}る (to simmer on medium heat)
- {中火|なかび}にする (to set to medium heat)
- {中火|なかび}に{落|お}とす (to reduce to medium heat)
